transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I hope I'm in the right place... I came in because, well, it's a little embarrassing to admit at my age, but I just feel like I cannot settle inside my own skin anymore. Does that make sense? 

It's probably just me making a fuss over nothing, but I always feel like I have to jump up and do the next thing... even when I'm completely worn out and I know I really should just be sitting still. I just can't seem to relax. Is that... is that an okay reason to be here?
Do you find yourself worrying a lot or feeling anxious about things, even when there's no clear reason to be?

Oh, um, no, not really. I mean, I hope I don't sound like a fretful person... I really try not to be. I don't sit around worrying about things when there's no reason to. It's not like my mind is full of scary thoughts or anything like that. 

It's really just that... that physical feeling of needing to be doing something, like I mentioned before. But as far as just feeling anxious or worried about life, no, I don't think I have that. I hope that's the right kind of answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the information you need.
Do you feel this restlessness or need to keep moving in specific situations, or does it happen more generally, even when you're at home or trying to unwind?

Well, um, it's really everywhere, even at home. I hope that doesn't make me sound too frantic... I just like to be helpful and keep things nice! But, yes, most days I just sort of... move from weeding the garden, right over to the senior center, and then I'll run my church errands, and the second I get back to the house I'm immediately sorting papers at the kitchen table. 

I just go and go without taking a real breath. It sounds a bit silly when I say it out loud, doesn't it? But it feels like... well, like if I were to actually stop and try to unwind, everything would just fall apart. I try my very best to be productive, I really do. Is that the kind of thing you were asking about?
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy lately?

Oh, no, definitely not. I hope I don't give the impression that I'm unhappy or ungrateful. I really try to keep a positive attitude! I don't feel sad or down at all. 

And as for losing interest... well, goodness, no. If anything, I have too much interest in everything! I still love my gardening and helping out at the church. It's just that I can't seem to do them at a normal pace, if that makes sense. But no, I'm not feeling depressed or anything like that. I'm a very cheerful person, usually! I hope that's helpful?
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are racing, or that you have more energy than usual, like you don’t need as much sleep as you used to?

Oh, goodness, no. I hope I don't seem like someone who's, you know, out of control or anything like that. I really do try to get a good night's rest! I sleep just fine, mostly. I don't have those times where I feel like I don't need sleep at all. 

And my thoughts... well, they might jump around a bit because I have so many lovely things to take care of, but they aren't racing in a scary way. I just like to stay on top of my chores and volunteer work, you know? I hope I'm explaining that right. I just wouldn't want you to think I'm losing my mind or acting strangely! Is that what you meant by racing thoughts?
Do you ever feel intense discomfort or anxiety in social situations, like when you're in the spotlight or interacting with others, such as when volunteering or speaking at church?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say I feel intense anxiety or anything like that. I really enjoy being around people! I hope I don't come across as anti-social or, you know, overly nervous. 

I mean, I suppose everyone gets a little flutter when they have to stand up in front of the church group to make an announcement, right? That's just normal, isn't it? But I certainly don't feel uncomfortable talking to folks at the senior center or running my errands. I love being helpful and friendly. I try very hard to make sure everyone feels comfortable around me. I hope that answers your question? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm afraid of people or anything.
Do you find yourself feeling very anxious or worried about a number of different things, even when you know you've done everything you can about them?

Oh, heavens, no, I wouldn't say I'm a worrier! I really try to just trust that things will work out, you know? I hope I don't seem like someone who's constantly fretting or making a fuss over nothing. 

I mean, I want to make sure my garden is doing well and that I haven't forgotten anything for the church bake sale, but that's just being responsible, isn't it? I certainly don't sit around feeling anxious all day. I try to keep busy and stay positive! I hope that's the right way to look at it? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm unnecessarily stressed or anything like that. I'm doing fine in that department, really!
Do you often experience physical symptoms like stomachaches, headaches, or dizziness that seem to come out of nowhere and aren't clearly related to a specific problem or situation?

Oh, my, no. I don't really get things like that. I mean, I hope you don't think I'm one of those people who's always complaining about an ache or a pain! I try to be very tough, you know? 

Sometimes if I've been rushing around too much, maybe I'll get a little twinge in my head, but that's just from needing a glass of water, isn't it? I certainly don't have dizzy spells or stomachaches for no reason. I try to take very good care of my health! I eat my vegetables and stay active. I hope that's what you were looking for? I just want to assure you I'm quite healthy and not making a fuss over little things!
Have you ever had a time where you felt like you were worrying so much about different things that it was hard to control, and this happened more days than not for several months at a time?

Oh, goodness, no. I don't think I've ever had anything like that. I mean, I hope I don't sound like I'm hiding anything, but I really don't sit and worry for months on end. That sounds just awful, doesn't it? 

I always try to look on the bright side of things. If something needs fixing, I just try to fix it, or I pray on it and let it go. I certainly wouldn't let worry take over my life like that. I like to think I have a pretty good handle on things, you know? I hope it's okay that I don't have a lot of worries to report? I just try my best to be a cheerful person and not let things get me down.

Have you ever experienced sudden episodes where your heart races, you feel short of breath, or you're overwhelmed by a feeling of intense fear or discomfort, even when nothing dangerous seems to be happening?

Oh, my stars, no. I've never had anything like that happen. That sounds like a heart attack, doesn't it? Oh, I hope you don't think I'm the sort of person who gets all worked up over nothing. 

I mean, if a dog jumps out at me while I'm walking, well, anyone's heart would flutter a bit, wouldn't it? But just out of the blue? No, no, I'm very steady. I try to keep a very calm home, you know? I listen to my soft music and I don't let myself get flustered. I hope that's a good thing? I just wouldn't want you to worry that I'm having some sort of terrible spells. I'm doing just fine, really I am!
